paragraphs: Week 10 (Nov 13 – 17, Lectures 19 and 20) Teaching and Learning

7.3 Exponential functions: the definition and properties of the natural exponential function; general exponents; the number e expressed as a limit; derivative of general exponential functions; general logarithmic functions.
(7.4 is not skipped --- instead, it will be discussed at the end of the term when we talk about differential equations.)
7.5 Indeterminate forms and L’Hôpital’s rule: indeterminate forms; L’Hôpital’s (or L’Hospital’s) rule. (Proof is optional.)

7.8 Relative rates of growth: comparing growth rates of functions and formal definitions; big-O and little-o notation; a technique for computing limits of products of quotients by replacing a function with one with the same growth rate (等价代换) --- this technique is not explicitly stated in the book --- see the file “1001lec20 2022”. (If not able to finish this chapter this week, can continue next week.)
